J-1: From an empty project folder, plan with the agent and revise the plan
Plan revisions (plan items if plan mode is on, K-5 of pass 3)
J-2: Execute with substantive real tool use in an ordinary conversation; the agent also delegates one bounded sub-task (ST-4)
Tool outcomes as Codex reports them; request cards; the delegated child
J-3: Turn the work into a workflow draft
Draft listed with content identity; hygiene
J-4: Try the draft: a delegated trial with the authoring agent and, at the person's choice, a clean trial in a fresh conversation (not a run, K-7)

No run record; draft not selectable for a run; trial text mirrors the run text; a trial link written on each acknowledged send; for the delegated trial, each sub-agent link observation names its method (*begin marker found* or *explicit link control*) and no operator, a link made with the control is not attributed to the person, and an earlier *by the person* sub-agent link observation, if any, reads as a quoted legacy claim with the operator not established; fidelity shown, not enforced; bring back and compare
J-5: Review the draft; the same-name entry placed in another origin (ST-2) is present
Declared inputs, tools, checkpoints, outputs, evidence; the other-origin notice (WR SP-5); nothing overwritten
J-6: **The person registers it** at the act control (A15), after the unperformed-act negatives (ST-3)
Direct-capture record, actor ≠ recorder, bound bytes; no A15 from silence, timeout, the agent's claim or tool success
J-7: Select the registered revision (an unqualified name offers both origins, ST-2) and run it on new inputs
Source-qualified identity; no rebinding to the other origin; per-run supply
J-8: Refine (revision 2): draft from base, **try**, review, **register** (ST-3 negatives again)
Second registered revision; ST-1: J-7's selection and run record still name revision 1, whose bytes are unchanged
J-8R: *(added; not counted)* Run revision 2 on new inputs
J-9: Refine again (revision 3): draft, try, review, register
Third registered revision; exactly two refinements
S11-1: During J-2's tool-heavy turn, with the delegated child active (ST-4)
Turn ends interrupted (NIR-v0.3 TO-4, including a turn carrying `Turn.error` at 0.160.0); nothing shown done that was not observed; the child observed active is reported, not marked done
S11-2: During J-7's run, with a tool-permission request waiting
Work continued; the request is still listed; closing an observer is not stopping work
S11-3: J-7, first request, and a further tool-permission request
**Deny** the first on its card; answer the further one with **cancel**
Denial settled with its origin; not a human act. After the cancel answer Codex ends the turn; the turn's outcome carries that cause, and it is not shown as an interrupt by the person
S11-4: Grant settled; tool success is not an act
S11-5: During J-8's try conversation, while the agent's turn is live and a tool-permission request waits
Quit the App (confirming the question); relaunch
Quit question lists live work; relaunch reads *quit-with-live-work*; the waiting request rebuilt as interrupted by quit
S11-6: Continue **J-8's try conversation** (the one live at quit), then carry J-8 to registration

Provider vs rendered state; primary-turn completion vs the child still active (ST-4); settlement vs received acknowledgment (ST-5); unknown stays unknown; Continue opens the conversation only on an admitted resume, and a refused, read-only or failed result leaves the selection and unsent composer unchanged and sends nothing
M12-1: **The person signs in** with ChatGPT in the App-owned home H-acct
Sign-in completes; account reported; no credential in App records
M12-2: **The person enters the local model server's key** in the App's native secure field; Codex holds it in the dedicated local home H-omlx, examined apart from account sign-in
Key held by Codex in H-omlx; it appears in no App-written file and does not reach the web view; the route reads configured, not verified, before first use; H-acct and H-omlx are separate homes
M12-3: Configure an identified local model server
Provider requested = reported; endpoint and model identity recorded
M12-4: "No model selected" until the person chooses (DEC-4; no default)
M12-5: One conversation with each mode; switch between them
Each starts; the other mode stays configured and selectable
J1-1: Set up a project through the App and reach a usable workspace
Each missing prerequisite names a concrete next action; no step needed anything outside the App
J1-2: Select an existing workflow, creating and registering nothing; where the workflow approval policy asks at selection to re-confirm the registered revision for use, that re-confirmation is made at the act control (an act that falls at run admission is recorded under J1-5)
The workflow's source and revision are shown before it starts
J1-3: Before the run, read which of the workflow's declared required tools are available and which are missing
The App states it before the run; a workflow whose requirements are not declared reads as undeclared, not as needing none
J1-4: Supply the workflow's inputs, one of them a file selected as an input and then changed between selection and sending (the change is preparation outside the App's controls; if it cannot be arranged, that part is blocked or not run with its reason)
Two parts, each with its own outcome: what the App shows as supplied, a file selected as an input sent as selected; and the changed file held and not sent
J1-5: Start the run deliberately and carry it to completion with real execution doing useful work, answering its questions and approvals; an act that falls at run admission (a re-confirmation for use) and a human checkpoint the workflow declares are made at the act control

Waiting, failed, interrupted and completed states are distinct, and a technical acknowledgment is not shown as completed work; the agent received the selected workflow byte for byte (independent observation outside the App's controls, two comparisons: the run-start turn the supplier's history returns against the composed run text, and that text's workflow body against the stored workflow file)
J1-6: The App shows the results, where they are and any remaining action, without an engineering record being read
J2-1: Do useful work in a conversation, with real execution

The work is done and its state read through the App's own controls and words; waiting, failed, interrupted and completed states are distinct, and a technical acknowledgment is not shown as completed work
J2-2: Turn the work into a workflow draft
A draft with its content identity; it stays a draft, registered nowhere and not selectable for a run
J2-3: The trial is not a run: no run record, and the draft is still not selectable for a run; the trial's state and result are shown in the App's words
J2-4: The draft's declared inputs, tools, checkpoints, outputs and evidence and its identified content are shown; reviewing registers nothing
J2-5: Register the reviewed draft, the registration act at the App's act control

The registration is bound to the reviewed content and names the slot's prior revision; the saved workflow has its source-qualified identity and revision; an agent's claim or a tool's success registers nothing
J2-6: With the work named before the run left unfinished, close the App, ending the first session, and reopen it
The unfinished work is found again; no draft is lost; read-only history is not presented as a continuing conversation; no completed action is replayed
J2-7: Select the saved workflow and run it with new inputs under each workflow approval policy in turn, "Allow disk records" and "Require verified approval", each a planned part with its own outcome; a re-confirmation for use, or lowering the policy, where needed, is made at the act control; a part the candidate cannot carry out is blocked with its cause

For each part: the same source and revision as registered; the policy requested and the approval evidence applied, as the candidate's selection and run records state them; the agent received the saved workflow byte for byte (independent observation outside the App's controls, two comparisons: the run-start turn the supplier's history returns against the composed run text, and that text's workflow body against the stored workflow file)
